findings_qualitative.value: Image-plane and visibility fits agree for TW Hya, but image-plane fitting has pitfalls (covariance, fidelity)

claims.hypothesis: TW Hya is substantially turbulent as reported by T16
claims.experiment: Fit ALMA CO(2-1) visibilities with a self-consistent parametric model
claims.result: δv_turb<0.08 cs (3σ), range 0.04-0.13 cs across variants
claims.finding: Turbulence is weak, below T16's 0.2-0.4 cs

evidence.quote: All of these fall below the turbulent broadening inferred by T16

claims.hypothesis: Calibration, CO abundance, or image-plane fitting explain the discrepancy
claims.experiment: ±20% flux scaling, lower CO abundance, variable gamma, image-plane fit
claims.result: limits stay below T16 in all cases
claims.finding: These are not the source of the discrepancy

evidence.quote: These tests result in variations of the turbulence limit between $<$0.04c$_s$ and $<$0.13c$_s$, consistently lower than the 0.2-0.4c$_s$ found previously.

claims.hypothesis: Temperature-density coupling or CO layering causes the difference
claims.finding: Likely hydrostatic coupling and/or thin CO layer

evidence.quote: the source of the discrepancy between our result and T16 likely lies in the coupling between temperature and density through hydrostatic equilibrium
